testcase.name: real replay, sensor evidence, pinned questions and keyboard navigation
asking a question opens Agents before its task detail read completes
automatic report timestamps are explicit and failed analysis cannot clear a numerical warning
default view prioritizes map, trend and assessment while optional tools stay collapsed
light theme has readable contrast and the map, chart and legend agree on pressure anomalies
two customer modes separate individual sensor alerts from agent investigation on matching S1 data
agent work stays separate from a running detector and rejects mismatched automatic handoffs
